subject: Cloud marketplace costing discovery — private offer & unit-price mapping
messages:

Subject: Cloud marketplace costing discovery — private offer & unit-price mapping

Hi Jamie — great to chat earlier. Quick recap from my side and a couple of asks so we can map the right marketplace private-offer structure: 

Call highlights (short):
- Use case: multitenant customer support assistant (real-time chat + occasional bulk embedding for search reindex).
- Preferred deployment route: AWS Marketplace private offer (procurement preference), but they may evaluate GCP/Azure listings too.
- Important for procurement: single unit price that maps to a $/1M tokens metric for PO and Cloud marketplace SKU.

What we need from you to draft an initial private-offer proposal: 
1) Expected steady-state token consumption (per month) + typical burst/peak window (1h/day peak). If ranges, please include low/median/high.
2) Target budget range (monthly committed spend) for a 12-month term.
3) Any mandatory PO terms: e.g., invoicing entity, required PO fields, SOW/attachment expectations.
4) Is there an internal target $/1M tokens (or an equivalent acceptable CPM) you can share? If not, give target monthly spend and we’ll reverse-engineer.

Attachment: I’m attaching a short CSV template (nimbus_token-estimates.csv) — if you can fill the three rows (monthly low/med/high tokens) that will speed things up.

Next steps: if you send the numbers, we’ll produce: (a) a preliminary unit-price mapping across AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace listings that meets your target spend, (b) a draft private-offer price grid for procurement, and (c) recommended ramp / commitment options.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen

Subject: Re: Cloud marketplace costing discovery — private offer & unit-price mapping

Thanks Stephanie — appreciated the clear list. See answers below and attached PO requirements PDF.

Token estimates (monthly) — approximate, current pilot traffic + expected 2x in Q4: 
- Low: 6,500,000 tokens/month
- Median: 12,000,000 tokens/month
- High: 28,000,000 tokens/month (peak scenario with heavy reindexing)
Peak load: typical 1-hour burst where qps rises ~3x; latency requirement is 250–400ms p50 for chat paths.

Budget / commitment: procurement is targeting an annualized committed spend between $60k–$200k (total contract value) for the first 12 months. They prefer 12-month term commitments with quarterly usage reconciliation.

Target $/1M tokens: procurement doesn’t have a strict dollar target, but they signaled that anything ~ $200–$350 / 1M tokens is plausible depending on SLA and support. They specifically asked for a marketplace private offer (AWS) so billing flows through their AWS account.

Procurement notes (from the attached):
- PO needs: vendor legal name, tax ID, invoice cadence, ARN for AWS private-offer acceptance path (if applicable).
- Standard redlines: liability cap tied to fees, data handling appendix required (SOC2 + data retention), renewal auto-rate review clause.

See attached: nimbus_po-requirements.pdf (outlines procurement contacts and mandatory fields).

Happy to hop on a short call if you want to walk through the PDF with our procurement lead (I can loop them in).

—Jamie

jamie@nimbuslabs.com | +1 (206) 555-0122

Subject: Re: Cloud marketplace costing discovery — private offer & unit-price mapping

Looping in quick internal take based on Jamie’s numbers — mapping notes and assumptions (for Stephanie to include in the proposal):

Assumptions:
- Marketplace fees: assume AWS takes ~10–12% marketplace fee on top of Redwood list price (varies by program).
- Token/unit definition: we’ll price using Redwood’s standard $/1M tokens (generation + embedding). We need to decide whether embeddings are discounted (recommend 0.6x for embeddings).

Preliminary unit-price recommendations (gross list before marketplace cut) given Nimbus target spend band $60k–$200k / year: 
- Scenario A (conservative): median 12M tokens/mo => annual ~144M tokens -> target gross list price =~ $300 / 1M tokens => ~ $43k/mo (annualized $516k) — this is above their stated TCV so probably needs tiering / commitment discount.
- Scenario B (aligned to procurement): to hit ~$150k TCV (midpoint), net effective should be ~ $180 / 1M tokens (after marketplace). That implies gross list price ~ $200 / 1M tokens (assuming 10% marketplace fee nets to ~$180).

Recommendation: propose a 3-tier private-offer price grid: 
1) 0–10M tokens/mo -> $320 / 1M tokens (gross)
2) 10–25M tokens/mo -> $240 / 1M tokens (gross)
3) 25M+ tokens/mo -> $190 / 1M tokens (gross)

Notes: with a 12-month commitment and quarterly reconciliation we can offer an additional 10% committed discount off the grid. For AWS private offer we’ll produce a mapping table showing: private-offer SKU unit price (per 1M tokens), gross list, marketplace fee, and estimated net to Redwood.

Action items for proposal pack (Stephanie / Karthik):
- Fill the pricing worksheet with the three tiers and add expected monthly volume rows for Nimbus (Ben will provide an initial worksheet).
- Include a short note on embedding discount and SLA uplift options (support + 99.9% uptime package).
- Prepare a draft private-offer acceptance instruction (how Nimbus accepts via AWS console).

Ben
Head of Marketplace Sales | Redwood Inference

Thanks Jamie — this is exactly what we needed. I’ve attached the pricing worksheet (redwood-pricing-worksheet.xlsx) and a short example mapping for AWS private offer acceptance. High level next steps and proposed timeline: 

1) You: confirm the monthly token numbers in the attached CSV and share procurement lead contact details (name + email).
2) Redwood: we’ll produce the 3-tier private-offer price grid (gross list + marketplace fee column + estimated net $/1M tokens) and a draft PO-ready pricing appendix for your procurement team. Expected deliverable: 48 business hours after we receive the completed CSV and procurement contact.
3) Joint: 30-minute PO walk-through meeting (procurement + Ben + me) to confirm acceptance flow and required PO fields.

Quick note on target pricing math (so everyone’s aligned):
- If Nimbus wants net ~$200 / 1M tokens, we’ll present a gross list price ~ $222 / 1M tokens (assume 10% marketplace fee).
- We’ll include a worked example in the worksheet for median 12M tokens/mo showing monthly invoice to Nimbus (via AWS) and expected Redwood net after marketplace fee.

Attachment: redwood-pricing-worksheet.xlsx (pricing grid + worked examples). I’ve also added a DocuSign placeholder link for the draft pricing appendix so procurement can review terms before the PO: https://redwood-inference.app/docusign/packet/DEAL-4592

Would you like Ben or Karthik on the procurement call next week? We have availability Tue/Wed morning PST.

Thanks — looking forward to the numbers.
